title: Super Fast: Saucy Vegan Pumpkin Ravioli
subtitle: On the table in under 20 minutes!
description: Five easy steps, minimal pans and prep… we cut the fluff but not the flavour in our 'super-fast' recipes. In just 20 minutes, you’ll have this masterpiece on the table and be crowned in glory too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Peel the pumpkin and cut into 2cm chunks. Finely chop the onion.

Cook pumpkin: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the ravioli. Put the pumpkin and 1 tbs water in a microwave-safe bowl, cover and microwave on high for 5 mins or until tender (see Kitchen notes). Meanwhile, heat a generous drizzle of olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Increase the heat to medium-high.

Make sauce: Add the tomatoes, pumpkin, 1 tsp dried oregano, 3 tsp pepper and garlic seasoning (see Kitchen notes), 60ml (¼ cup) plant-based milk and 1 tbs tomato paste to the onion and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until combined. Remove the pan from the heat. Blend the tomato mixture with a stick blender or food processor until smooth (see Kitchen notes).

Cook ravioli: Cook the ravioli in the pan of boiling water for 3 mins or until al dente. Drain. Add the ravioli to the sauce over medium heat and gently stir until the ravioli is coated and the sauce is warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Divide the ravioli among bowls and enjoy!

Kitchen notes: Don't have a microwave? Simply cook the pumpkin in a pan of boiling water for 10-12 mins until soft, then drain. ~ Our pepper and garlic seasoning has a mild peppery kick, so reduce the amount if you prefer less heat. ~ If you don't have a stick blender or food processor, mash the tomato mixture with a potato masher. The result won't be as smooth but it will be just as delicious!
